name: BidBrain
summary: AI that reads electrical plan PDFs and returns a priced estimate.
differentiator: Shows a sample priced estimate on the page and says it applies material substitutions and labor factors from drawing notes, but names no price source, assembly library or labor-unit standard.
pricing: No price published on the pages we read. The page says no demo call or contract is required.

scope.takeoff: Reads panel schedules, circuits, devices and fixtures from PDF plans, and counts outlets, GFCI locations and raceway lengths.
scope.library: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.laborUnits: Says it applies labor factors from drawing notes. No labor-unit source is named.

materialPrices.note: Says it prices materials against "live retail data". The source is not named.

bestFor: Shops that want to try an AI estimate without a sales call.
skipIf: You need to know where the prices and labor numbers come from.
watchOut: The sample estimate on the page is an illustration, not a result we checked.
